response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the fit against this role's mandatory requirements is very weak. Hands-on C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, more than a decade ago, versus the required 5–10 years of current C++ work. There is no evidence of Windows-platform development, no SQL Server or Oracle depth (SQL listed generically alongside MySQL/MongoDB), and no fixed income, derivatives, investment banking, or capital markets domain exposure — the closest adjacency is a fintech/investment startup (RIDE Capital) using Node/TypeScript/GraphQL. Strengths in TDD, CI/CD, low-latency systems, and communication are genuine but cannot substitute for the core C++ plus financial-domain requirements.
strengths: Strong engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, testing tooling
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Excellent communication evidenced by talks, workshops, and courses delivered
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience, dating back to 2014–2015
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets/investment banking domain exposure
No demonstrated Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle database experience

key_factors.factor: Windows platform and enterprise SQL (SQL Server/Oracle)
